name: Chicco Fit2 (Rear-Facing 2-Year)

verifiedAttributes._comment: carrierLb / fitsWayfinder / fitsAlterrain / safety map into seed.json; rest is audit trail.
verifiedAttributes.safety: Extended rear-facing to ~2 yr (4-35 lb, to 35"); integrated anti-rebound bar; EPS energy-absorbing foam for side-impact; meets/exceeds federal side-impact standard; FAA-approved; ReclineSure leveling foot + RideRight bubble levels.
verifiedAttributes.bobWayfinderAdapter: none - Fit2 is NOT on the BOB Wayfinder universal list (Wayfinder covers Nuna/Cybex/Maxi-Cosi/Britax Willow/Diono only).
verifiedAttributes.bobAlterrainAdapter: BOB Gear Infant Car Seat Adapter - Single, Chicco (brand-specific), ~$50 (verify exact price). Fit2 explicitly listed on Strolleria's BOB Alterrain / Alterrain Pro compatible-seat list.
verifiedAttributes.tacomaFitNotes: No direct seat-specific Toyota Tacoma data found. The Fit2 has one of the largest/deepest rear-facing footprints of any infant seat (heaviest carrier in this batch at ~12.3 lb; engineered to last rear-facing all the way to 35"). Chicco lists overall stage dims ~28"L x 17"W x 24"H. In a Tacoma double-cab (shallow front-to-back rear seat) a rear-facing Fit2 will likely force the front seat well forward; CPST guidance for RF installs in a Tacoma commonly recommends an angle adjuster (Car Crash Detective). No Tacoma 3-across data found for this seat.

notes: Price: Chicco's own store lists the original Fit2 at $329.99 (DTC price machine-verified 2026-06-07); the refreshed 'Fit2 Adapt' variant is $339.99 on the same site. Amazon and buybuy BABY listings are live but their prices are protected by anti-bot blocks and could not be machine-read on 2026-06-07 - both recorded at the current $329.99 list tier and should be re-verified by the integration pass; Target and Walmart also carry it. MSRP fallback (~$300) is sane. carrierLb corrected up from stub's 9 to ~12.3 lb (it is notably heavy). Alterrain compat CONFIRMED (Strolleria Alterrain list names Fit2); Wayfinder NOT compatible - matches expected Alterrain-only. Image is the original Fit2 (Tempo) product shot, not the Adapt.
